nodes.name: cloud-run-service.yaml
nodes.summary: Knative/Cloud Run Service manifest for a container named 'mcathcat' (autoscaling 0-10, 2Gi/2vCPU, port 8080, 300s timeout). Legacy artifact from the abandoned Cloud Run deployment path — the project now deploys exclusively to Vercel.
nodes.languageNotes: Knative serving.knative.dev/v1 Service with run.googleapis.com annotations for CPU throttling, memory and scaling bounds.

nodes.name: mountains.json
nodes.summary: The multi-tenant source of truth: per-mountain public configuration (branding, Korean about-page copy and photos, host domains, storagePrefix, theme, features, social links) for the 'geyang' and 'manisan' tenants, plus a _shared block and _meta version stamp.
nodes.languageNotes: Underscore-prefixed keys (_meta, _shared) are reserved and must be excluded when iterating tenant ids; secrets are never stored here — they are merged in from env at read time.

nodes.name: permissions.json
nodes.summary: Declarative RBAC matrix defining four roles (admin, butler-ground, butler-internet, viewer) with their permission lists, plus a per-mountain block naming admin users and the default role for each tenant.
nodes.languageNotes: The mountains block must stay coherent with config/mountains/mountains.json — a new tenant needs an entry in both files.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Tenant-scoped 개인정보처리방침 (Privacy Policy) route — a static prose Server Component implementing the PIPA Art. 30 disclosure, grounded in what the app actually collects.
nodes.languageNotes: Next.js App Router page exporting a `metadata` object; a local Section helper composes the repeated heading/body prose blocks.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Tenant-scoped 이용약관 (Terms of Use) route — a static prose Server Component covering service terms and liability disclaimers for member sign-up, community posts and YouTube video uploads.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet: Tailwind layer imports, the :root design tokens (including the --color-primary per-tenant brand variable the [mountain] layout overrides), base heading styles, line-clamp utilities, and the shared keyframe animation library for modals, dropdowns and bubble effects.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Tailwind's @layer base/@layer utilities with @apply, and exposes --color-primary as the single per-tenant theming hook (default #facc15 = geyang yellow).

nodes.name: layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Root App Router layout — the tenant-independent HTML shell providing the Inter font, global CSS, base metadata/viewport, and the conditionally rendered GA4 gtag snippet. All tenant-scoped providers and chrome live in [mountain]/layout.tsx instead.
nodes.languageNotes: GA4 loads only when NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID is set, and configures send_page_view:false so AnalyticsTracker can attach mountain_id to every page_view.

nodes.name: CatTagField.tsx
nodes.summary: Controlled comma-separated cat-tag input for the admin media tagging pages, rendering current tags as removable chips and delegating cat selection to a page-owned CatSelectorModal.

nodes.name: MediaGrid.tsx
nodes.summary: Generic card-grid container with an empty state for the admin media tagging pages; the per-item card rendering is injected as a render-prop slot so pages keep ownership of badges, thumbnails and selection wiring.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic over `T extends { id: string }`, keeping the grid reusable across image and video item shapes.

nodes.name: MediaStatsCards.tsx
nodes.summary: Purely presentational statistics card row (total / untagged / tagged / needs-date-parse) for the admin media tagging pages; the pages compute the numbers and choose each card's accent color.

nodes.name: PaginationBar.tsx
nodes.summary: Numbered pagination controls with a configurable odd-sized sliding page window (7 for tag-images, 5 for tag-videos), rendering nothing when there is only a single page.

nodes.name: useDateAutoParse.ts
nodes.summary: Shared 자동 날짜 인식 hook for the admin media tagging pages: finds items missing a creation date but with a parseable one, processes them with per-item progress feedback, persists each date through an injected updater, and returns a success/failure report.
nodes.languageNotes: Dependency-injection style generic hook — needsDate/parse/applyUpdate/mergeParsedDate are all supplied by the caller, so no service-layer coupling leaks into the hook.

nodes.name: PrivacyPolicyPage
nodes.summary: Default-exported Server Component rendering the full Korean privacy policy document, section by section, including the privacy officer contact and effective date constants.

nodes.name: TermsOfUsePage
nodes.summary: Default-exported Server Component rendering the full Korean terms-of-use document with its effective date and liability disclaimers.

nodes.name: RootLayout
nodes.summary: Renders the html/body shell with the Inter font class and, when a GA4 measurement id is configured, injects the gtag loader and init scripts before the children.

nodes.name: CatTagField
nodes.summary: Renders the tag text input plus a cat-selector trigger and chip list, with a removeTag helper that splits, trims, filters and rejoins the comma-separated value on removal.

nodes.name: MediaGrid
nodes.summary: Maps the item list through the caller-supplied renderCard slot into a responsive grid, falling back to the provided empty message when there are no items.

nodes.name: MediaStatsCards
nodes.summary: Maps the supplied MediaStatCard descriptors into a row of labelled stat cards with optional per-card value coloring and note lines.

nodes.name: PaginationBar
nodes.summary: Computes the sliding window of page numbers around the current page and renders previous/next plus numbered buttons, clamping page changes with Math.min/Math.max before invoking onPageChange.

nodes.name: useDateAutoParse
nodes.summary: Generic React hook that memoizes the set of parseable-but-undated items, then sequentially parses and persists each date while tracking parsing state and per-item processing ids, returning an aggregated success/failure report.
